summary: Mismatched payee identifier blocking scheduled vendor payments and failing PO match
description:
Issue summary: Several scheduled ACH payments for supplier 'Caldera Analytics' are in 'Held' state in the payments queue. The bank reconciliation feed shows the payments were created but failed to post to the corporate bank due to a payee identifier mismatch. At the same time, the invoice import pipeline rejected the invoice-to-PO match for the same supplier because the EDI invoice header omitted the PO number.

Impact: Three scheduled payments ($42,300 total) are blocked from releasing; month-end reconciliation is affected. The supplier sent multiple reminders via support@caldera-analytics.com and has asked for confirmation that payment will be released this week. Risk of late-fee penalties and supplier relationship impact.

Background: Caldera recently updated their banking details in the vendor portal last week. Finance updated the Vendor Master record on 2026-03-02 with the new ACH routing and payee tax identifier (TIN). On 2026-03-03 we ran a batch of scheduled payouts which now show 'Held: Payee ID mismatch'. The AP inbox contains an EDI 810 invoice for PO 78219 that was processed on 2026-03-04 but failed auto-match.

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Vendor Master: vendor_id V-00948 shows payee_tin=12-3456789, routing=021000021.
2) Payments queue (payments-service): payment_id P-20260303-77 created for V-00948 scheduled 2026-03-03 17:00Z.
3) Bank gateway returned code BK-415: "Beneficiary identifier mismatch" during pre-send validation.
4) Automated PO-matcher logged: "PO_NOT_FOUND: EDI 810 header missing PO#" for invoice INV-20260304-119.
5) Reconciliation feed (bank-feed-us-east) shows pending but not posted.

Observed logs (sanitized):
- payments-service[2026-03-03T17:00:02Z] ERROR payment_validator: payee_tin=12-3456789 != bank_record.tin=21-9876543 for payee V-00948; code=BK-415
- edi-ingest[2026-03-04T02:15:10Z] WARN matcher: invoice INV-20260304-119 header[PO]=null; fallback_route=vendor_reference

Expected behavior: Updated vendor bank/TIN should be accepted after Finance confirmation; scheduled payments should move from Held to Processing. EDI invoices containing a PO reference should auto-match to PO 78219 and flow to payment.

Actual behavior: System prevents payments due to discrepancy between Vendor Master and bank's stored beneficiary id. EDI pipeline is treating missing PO as non-match and routing to manual review queue.

Additional notes: Caldera's accounts payable team provided a bank confirmation PDF (attached to the ticket) and a copy of the original PO showing PO 78219. Finance believes the Vendor Master update succeeded but suspects there may be a duplication of vendor records with different internal vendor_id.

Attachments: caldera_bank_confirmation_20260302.pdf; edi_810_INV-20260304-119.raw

Suggested initial triage steps: Verify vendor duplicate records; cross-check bank-held beneficiary id with bank portal; check change history for V-00948; surface payments queue more detailed audit for the affected payments.
comments: 2026-03-05 09:14 - Maya Thompson: Opening ticket after supplier escalation. Ticket includes bank confirmation PDF and EDI invoice. Assigned to payments triage.

2026-03-05 10:05 - Finance Ops (R. Silva): Confirmed Vendor Master updated on 2026-03-02 by user laura. Change log shows single update to bank routing and TIN for V-00948. Noted possible duplicate vendor record V-0912 in legacy system.
2026-03-05 12:40 - Ethan Rodriguez: Investigating payments-service logs and bank gateway test endpoints. Reached out to Treasury to request bank-held beneficiary id lookup. Added label 'po-matching'.

2026-03-06 08:23 - Treasury (N. Patel): Bank responded via secure channel: beneficiary id at bank is 21-9876543 (legacy). They have a pending name-change request from vendor but internal bank record not updated. Bank suggests vendor submit signed confirmation form to update beneficiary id.

2026-03-07 15:02 - Ethan Rodriguez: Found duplicate vendor V-0912 in legacy CSV ingest. V-0912 has bank_tin 21-9876543 and was not merged. This explains mismatch: payments-service matched bank record to V-0912 while AP updated V-00948. Marking as root-cause hypothesis.

2026-03-08 11:11 - AP Lead (L. Chen): Drafted workaround: manually reconcile and reassign payment to vendor id V-0912 after Treasury confirms bank update, execute single urgent ACH via wire transfer for $12,500 to clear supplier priority invoice. Need approval from Head of Finance.
2026-03-09 09:34 - Head of Finance (A. Gupta): Approved one-off wire for priority invoice. Requested permanent fix for vendor merge and EDI header validation to surface missing PO to vendor upstream.

2026-03-10 14:00 - Ethan Rodriguez: Created a temporary playbook to run vendor-merge script for confirmed duplicates and added an automated alert for future bank_tin discrepancies. Preparing PR to edi-ingest to fail fast when PO header is missing and include vendor contact info in rejection notice. Link to PR in related_github_prs.
investigation_notes: Preliminary root cause: duplicate vendor records (V-00948 vs V-0912) with inconsistent bank TINs created race between Vendor Master updates and bank-held beneficiary id. EDI ingestion also lacks strict PO header validation allowing non-PO invoices which complicate auto-match. Treasury confirms bank record hasn't been updated so bank rejects ACH due to beneficiary identifier mismatch.
next_steps: 1) Treasury to request vendor-submitted beneficiary update form (in progress). 2) AP to execute approved one-off wire for priority invoice and mark remaining payments as pending reissue. 3) Engineering to open PR to add a pre-send check that links payment vendor_id to bank-held beneficiary id and surface detailed error with reconciliation guidance. 4) Engineering to patch edi-ingest to reject EDI 810s missing PO header by default and notify vendor via standardized rejection message. Target ETA for code changes: 2026-03-17.
